messages.Text:
The conversation so far:
Developer: What is a link token?
You: A link token is what authorises your system to link a care context to a patient's ABHA address. Your system obtains it when the patient registers, and stores it against that patient.

The developer's new message:
Does it expire?

hits.summary: The token that authorises your system to link a care context to a patient's ABHA address.
hits.title: Link token, the token that authorises linking

hits.summary: The link token you sent cannot authorise this link, so generate a new one rather than retrying.
hits.title: ABDM-1026, the link token is not valid

hits.summary: The link token arrives here; store it against the patient, because it is valid for six months.
hits.title: The link token you asked for, or why it was refused

hits.summary: Ask for a link token for one patient; it arrives on your bridge and is valid for six months.
hits.title: Generate Link Token

hits.summary: ABDM answers a link token request on the HIP's bridge, with the token or an error.
hits.title: Link token generation – Call Back API

hits.summary: The HIP links one or more care contexts to a patient's ABHA address, using the patient's link token.
hits.title: Link care contexts to an ABHA address

hits.summary: Tell ABDM that this patient had a visit at your facility so their records can be found and fetched later.
hits.title: Link a care context to a patient's ABHA

hits.summary: ABDM posts the code the patient entered and the link reference number; the HIP checks them and answers on-confirm.
hits.title: Confirmation of a link, carrying the token the patient approved

hits.summary: In linking the provider id does not match the link token, and in a consent flow the date range is not valid.
hits.title: ABDM-1063, HIP id mismatch, or an invalid date range

hits.summary: The second path for linking a beneficiary to the products they hold; it takes the same body as the main link call.
hits.title: POST /v2/participant/link/abha/policy

reply.Text:
Yes, link tokens expire after **six months**. You should store the link token against the patient when you receive it, since it remains valid for that six-month period.

This is documented in the ABDM developer portal under the [Link token generation callback](https://abdm.gov.in/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-callbacks/01-m2-post-v3-hip-token-on-generate-token#m2-on-generate-token-result) and [Generate Link Token endpoint](https://abdm.gov.in/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-abdm-link-token-hip/01-m2-post-v3-token-generate-token#m2-generate-link-token) pages.
